Vallenuova / Italian Hill Town — Little Elsewhere

Imagined Italian hill town; not a measured reconstruction of a real town.
Original local Italy scene adapted in place with little-worlds-3d.
Preserved closed stone-brick base, roof/wall clearance repairs, Ferrari detail view,
authored people/traffic routes, seeded layout and Day / Sunset / Night lighting.

Website adapter: /italy.html, /italy-world.css and the shared world-shell assets.
Editable ES modules live here. Three.js 0.180.0 is vendored under vendor/three.
Three.js MIT license is included in the exported HTML and main website notices.
Run `python3 scripts/export-italy.py /absolute/output/italy.html` at repository root
for an offline standalone copy. Run `npm run build` after editing website assets.
